title: The Power of Networking
bodyHtml:
The Power of Networking

The exciting program included talks about the introduction to the quantum computer, networking activities and an open-ended apéro.

The event organized by Dr. Nezhla Aghaee consisted of 3 talks by Dr. Ana I. Benítez-Mateos (introducing the pod of 500WS Bern-Fribourg), Dr. Sabine Höfler (as a representative from the Office of Gender Equiality), and Dr. Christa Zoufal and Dr. Elisa Baeumer from IBM (introducing quantum computers)

We enjoyed a cofee break and apèro while expanding our network (sponsored by the NCCR Digital Fabrication)!! Finally, the journalist Mrs. Ariane Lüthi talked to us about women in business and diplomacy
